description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeProfilePictureController class, which manages the employee profile picture view in the OrangeHRM system. It handles pre-render logic to set up components and permissions related to employee photographs.

classes.name: EmployeeProfilePictureController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the employee profile picture interface, including permissions and component setup.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by setting up the component with employee data and permissions if the 'empNumber' attribute exists in the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the array of data groups required for capability permission checks, specifically related to employee photographs.
